# 223. Rectangle Area

## Solution 1 (time O(1), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def computeArea(self, ax1, ay1, ax2, ay2, bx1, by1, bx2, by2):
        """
        :type ax1: int
        :type ay1: int
        :type ax2: int
        :type ay2: int
        :type bx1: int
        :type by1: int
        :type bx2: int
        :type by2: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        s1 = abs(ax1 - ax2) * abs(ay1 - ay2)
        s2 = abs(bx1 - bx2) * abs(by1 - by2)
        x1 = max(ax1, bx1)
        x2 = min(ax2, bx2)
        y1 = max(ay1, by1)
        y2 = min(ay2, by2)
        if x1 < x2 and y1 < y2:
            s3 = (x2 - x1) * (y2 - y1)
        else:
            s3 = 0
        return s1 + s2 - s3
```
